people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
translations.bsb: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.
translations.kjv: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
translations.asv: And he was king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people were gathered, All the tribes of Israel together.
